Cox1958.sentence: Logistic regression [@Cox1958] is a common default because it fits a decision boundary to the data, whereas a nearest-centroid rule only compares distances to the class means.

Fisher1936.sentence: The nearest-centroid rule uses this boundary, and it is also the linear discriminant of @Fisher1936 for this covariance.

Pedregosa2011.sentence: Both classifiers are available in standard libraries such as scikit-learn [@Pedregosa2011], so the benchmark can be extended to those settings.
